name: ie-cat
description: Ireland's Capital Acquisitions Tax (CAT) on gifts and inheritances for 2026. Covers the single 33% rate; the Group A, B and C thresholds in two 2026 periods (EUR 400,000 / 40,000 / 20,000 for benefits taken to 6 October 2026, and EUR 420,000 / 44,000 / 22,000 from 7 October 2026 under Finance (No. 2) Bill 2026 s.66, which Revenue already applies); aggregation since 5 December 1991; the EUR 3,000 small gift exemption; the spouse and civil partner exemption; dwelling house exemption; agricultural and business relief at 90%; valuation date; the 31 October pay-and-file date and the 80% IT38 filing trigger; late filing surcharge, under-valuation surcharge and interest; residence, domicile and foreign tax credits. Trigger on 'Irish inheritance tax', 'Irish gift tax', 'CAT threshold', 'Group A', 'IT38', 'small gift exemption', 'dwelling house exemption', 'agricultural relief', 'business relief'. Out of scope: capital gains tax (ie-cgt), residence and domicile in depth (ie-cross-border, ie-non
